status_definitions.supported: Supported by multiple controlled results but revisable.
status_definitions.falsified: The stated form failed a decisive test.
status_definitions.superseded: Replaced by a more precise formulation.

hypotheses.statement: The resource-normalized successor-generating operator contains essential RSI information not captured by task capability alone.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Compare systems with matched task capability but different descendant-generation performance.

hypotheses.statement: Improvement efficiency eta is a useful macrostate for comparing recursive improvement across generations.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Test whether eta predicts descendant quality across domains and scales better than current capability alone.

hypotheses.statement: The optimal harness changes materially as the model changes.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Evaluate a fixed harness portfolio across successive model versions and measure rank stability and interaction.

hypotheses.statement: Alternating cheap harness exploration with verified model internalization is more efficient long-run than model-only or harness-only updating.
Candidate search has a fidelity-dependent phase boundary beyond which more search mainly selects noise or exploits.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Sweep evaluator fidelity and candidate count against an independent ground-truth test.

hypotheses.statement: Portfolio and lineage search outperform greedy replacement when models and task distributions are nonstationary.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Compare greedy, beam, lineage-aware, and diversity-preserving search under equal budgets across model updates.

hypotheses.statement: The sign of recursive design gain minus complexity and verification debt predicts whether improvement efficiency grows or decays.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Fit the nonlinear dynamics and test out-of-sample forecasts under different intervention schedules.

hypotheses.statement: Transferable self-improvement will be substantially more common than successors that are better improvers.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Run parent-versus-successor improvement tests for every transferable successor.

hypotheses.statement: Improver quality is not reducible to task-solving capability.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Cross evolver, executor, and evaluator models while controlling for task capability.

hypotheses.statement: Adaptive resource allocation across model, harness, improver, data, and evaluation outperforms fixed update schedules.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Compare fixed, greedy, and model-predictive allocation under equal multi-generation budgets.

hypotheses.statement: The benefit of a self-improvement intervention can be non-monotone with model capability or scale.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Apply identical interventions across multiple model families and capability levels.

hypotheses.statement: Evidence-bearing matched trajectories produce more transferable learning than equal-token successful-trace training.
hypotheses.decisive_test: Train matched model updates on causal/evidence-rich versus success-only datasets.
